why: Two defects in the KB's own strings: FAULT_14's mechanism contains a mangled degree sign (a U+FFFD in place of the degree symbol) and its action is written in emergency language that the event does not support; the KB also repeats an equipment phrase in one place. The KB files are not edited; this overlay is applied after loading and is hashed in the run output.

14.recommended_action: Dispatch a field technician to stroke the cooling water valve XMV_51 and to open the manual jacket bypass. If the reactor temperature keeps climbing, reduce the reactant feeds on the A feed line, the D feed header and the combined feed header.
text_repairs: Extreme risk of thermal runaway and emergency relief venting!
Sustained heat generation with reduced jacket removal risks a reactor trip.
